title: One chat-turn module for web, Discord and YouTube
evidence: Brad approved one shared chat-turn module (2026-11-11). Step 1 done: one chat_match_events row builder, matchEventRow in app/lib/chat-persist.server.ts, used by app/routes/api.chat.ts (web and the iPhone app, which runs the web turn through app/lib/app-routes.server.ts), app/lib/discord-bot-persist.server.ts and app/lib/youtube-bot-store.server.ts (US-15 AC73). Step 2 begun: runRouter in app/lib/chat-router-stage.server.ts runs the router and reports its failure once for all three surfaces (US-15 AC74, H414). Left, in order: (2) the rest of the router stage: the classifier gate, preferMasters and loadMatchedArticlesFromHandles, still copied in api.chat.ts, platform-chat.server.ts and youtube-bot-pipeline.server.ts; fold them into runRouter as one routeTurn with each surface's masters options; (3) the router's view of history (first and recent user turns), computed in api.chat.ts, platform-chat.server.ts and again in discord-bot.server.ts for persist; (4) one answer-row builder (three literals; Discord adds discord_message_id, YouTube trims); (5) the question row and conversation create, after the owner rules on timing and failure paths (S-2); (6) the turn module itself: guard, classify, route, system blocks, model call, persist, with posture, limits, history and tools passed in by each surface.
